prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI asset sheet for Black Forest, hand painted dark fairy tale with antique brass, midnight indigo enamel, restrained luminous gems. Transparent background. Exactly SIX isolated icons in a perfectly regular 3 column x 2 row square sheet, each icon centered within its cell, all with large transparent margins (at least 18% cell width), no objects crossing cells. Row1: (1) ACTION ENERGY: beautiful antique brass lantern medallion with a bold brilliant cyan lightning bolt inside blue glass; readable silhouette, thick metal rim. (2) SPIRIT: antique bronze teardrop talisman containing a luminous amber flame, subtle red binding cord. (3) MENU: closed midnight-blue leather travel satchel with brass crescent clasp, frontal view. Row2: (4) DECK: three fanned indigo playing cards with large gold leaf motif, NO text or letters. (5) JOURNEY: rolled parchment map with a single brass compass and teal route line. (6) JOURNAL: open indigo-bound ivory storybook with brass corners and tiny gold quill. One consistent art direction, premium crafted inventory objects, clear chunky shapes visible at 32px, no fine clutter, no skulls, no labels, no typography, no numerals, no text, no checkerboard, true transparent alpha. Orthographic frontal or slight top down, no floor shadow, understated light, not photoreal plastic, not a UI mockup. Output square 1536x1536.
